plan.scope: UNAPPROVED visual-only correction for actual VS three projectile slots. Preserve exact captured actionMap and all combat resources/timings. shoot/deploy/charge now use native rifle aim role11 during active phase, never optic9 or unarmedpunch6. Core taxonomy remains a separate proof requirement.

concept.description: Personalized Revengeance-style precision cyborg: olive/charcoal layered ceramic armor, exposed braided actuators and genuinely articulated mechanical limbs, stronger black anatomical-left arm assembly recalling her long sleeve, olive anatomical-right precision hand, shoulder/cheek interfaces designed for her conventional sniper rifle, low-profile backpack and practical articulated boots. No generic shiny cloth, no Raiden body copy, no extra limbs.

proposalLimits: Candidate pixel heights and pivots require physical review. A neutral pose on the same image can use a different drawn density; do not approve that value automatically.
Preview datum is proposed from contact pixels. Replace it with a reviewed pelvis/body axis where appropriate.
No source point is inferred from a gun bounding box. Native muzzle or release points must be supplied explicitly.
